card.name: Duration after treatment ends
card.fires_on: Words in a stated time span, such as 'one', 'days' or 'month', that set how long something lasts. Most often in contraception advice 'for one month after the last dose' and in 'at least 10 days' for infections.

modes.label: Contraception after last dose
modes.description: The number or unit in 'for one month/year after' the final dose.
modes.example: Advise use of effective contraception prior to initiation of treatment, during treatment, and for<< one>> month after treatment with riociguat

modes.label: Minimum treatment length
modes.description: The unit 'days' after 'at least 10' in antibiotic duration advice.
modes.example: treatment should be continued for at least 10<< days>>. Reconstitution Instructions

modes.label: Storage excursions
modes.description: The word 'permitted' after 'excursions' in storage temperature text.
modes.example: room temperature 25°C (77°F); excursions<< permitted>> to 15° to 3

card.writes: It seems to lower the chance of 'allowed' and rule-type words after a duration.
card.plain: It marks the length of time something must continue, like how many months to keep using contraception after the last dose.
